questions.subject: Economics

criteria.description: Correctly plots and labels the demand and supply curves, with appropriate axes and direction

evidence.quote:
I have
drawn the graph below by taking price on the horizontal axis and quantity on the vertical axis.

criteria.feedback: The answer says the opposite of the marking scheme about "price" (horizontal/vertical).
criteria.correction: The demand and supply data can be represented on a graph with quantity on the horizontal axis and price on the vertical axis .

criteria.description: Correctly identifies the equilibrium at ₹30 and 60 units and explains why it is equilibrium
criteria.feedback: The answer covers this rubric point.

criteria.description: Correctly explains shortage below equilibrium and surplus above equilibrium

evidence.quote:
If the price in the market goes above the equilibrium price then there will be a shortage in the market,
because the buyers will demand much more than what the sellers are ready to supply.

criteria.feedback: The answer pairs "above" with "shortage"; the marking scheme pairs "below" with "shortage" and "above" with "surplus".
criteria.correction: If the market price is below the equilibrium price , quantity demanded is greater than quantity supplied.

criteria.description: Correctly explains that increased production costs shift the supply curve left/upward

evidence.quote:
If the cost of production increases then the producers will not be able to supply the same quantity at the old
price, so the supply curve shifts to the left.

criteria.feedback: The answer covers this rubric point.

criteria.description: Correctly explains the resulting tendency toward a higher equilibrium price and lower equilibrium quantity, with the change represented appropriately on the graph

evidence.quote:
The new equilibrium will then be at a higher price and also at a
higher quantity, because when the price has gone up the sellers will sell more.

criteria.feedback: The answer says the opposite of the marking scheme about "quantity" (higher/lower).
criteria.correction: The new equilibrium would generally occur at a higher price and lower quantity , assuming demand remains unchanged.
